tooltip.microdrone.battery_desc: Hold and Right-Click drone to attach / Sneak Right-Click to detach (Fast recharge on Charging Station)
message.microdrone.pilot_start: §a[Drone] Piloting started. (W/S: Pitch/Forward, A/D: Strafe, Space/Shift: Elevate, Mouse: Yaw, Right Click with Controller: Exit)
message.microdrone.already_piloted: §c[Drone] This drone is already being piloted by another player!
message.microdrone.pilot_aborted_damage: §c[Warning] Your body took damage! Drone piloting emergency aborted.
message.microdrone.signal_lost_failsafe: §c[Warning] Radio signal lost! Emergency return failsafe activated.
message.microdrone.no_battery: §c[Drone] No battery installed! Hold a battery and right-click to install.
message.microdrone.charger.empty: [Charging Station] Slot is empty. Right-click with a battery to insert.
